subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A student's overall mental picture of who they are — including their perceived abilities, roles, personality traits, and characteristics — is called their:
explanation: Self-concept is the descriptive, overall mental picture a person holds of themselves — distinct from self-esteem (evaluative judgement of worth) and self-efficacy (belief in capability for a specific task).

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A student who generally feels 'I am a worthwhile and likeable person', reflecting an overall positive emotional evaluation of their own worth, has high:
explanation: Self-esteem is the evaluative, emotional judgement of one's own worth — distinct from self-concept (descriptive self-picture) and self-efficacy (task-specific capability belief).
